expression\");\n            int count = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));\n            int sides = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(2));\n            if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Count and sides must be positive\");\n            String modifierPart = matcher.group(3);\n            int modifier = modifierPart == null ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(modifierPart);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"dice_count\", count);\n            res.put(\"sides\", sides);\n            res.put(\"modifier\", modifier);\n            res.put(\"min\", count + modifier);\n            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleAbilityCheck(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> combatantsList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"combatants\");\n            if (combatantsList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing combatants\");\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Object combatantObj : combatantsList) {\n                Map<String, Object> combatant = (Map<String, Object>) combatantObj;\n                String name = (String) combatant.get(\"name\");\n                int dex = JsonUtils.toInt(combatant.get(\"dex\"));\n                int roll = JsonUtils.toInt(combatant.get(\"roll\"));\n                int score = roll + dex;\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", name);\n                out.put(\"score\", score);\n                out.put(\"_dex\", dex);\n                combatants.add(out);\n            }\n\n            combatants.sort((a, b) -> {\n                int scoreA = (Integer) a.get(\"score\");\n                int scoreB = (Integer) b.get(\"score\");\n                if (scoreB != scoreA)      String nameA = (String) a.get(\"name\");\n                String nameB = (String) b.get(\"name\");\n                return nameA.compareTo(nameB);\n            });\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> order = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Map<String, Object> combatant : combatants) {\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", combatant.get(\"name\"));\n                out.put(\"score\", combatant.get(\"score\"));\n                order.add(out);\n            }\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"order\", order);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleAbilityModifier(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n handleCombatSessionAction(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();\n        String prefix = \"/v1/combat/sessions/\";\n     return;\n        }\n        String id = rest.substring(0, slash);\n        String action = rest.substring(slash + 1);\n        CombatSession session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n        if (session == null) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Session not found\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            if (\"conditions\".equals(action)) {\n                String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n                Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n                String target = (String) req.get(\"target\");\n                String condition = (String) req.get(\"condition\");\n                int durationRounds = JsonUtils.toInt(req.get(\"duration_rounds\"));\n                if (target == null || condition == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n                if (durationRounds <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid duration\");\n\n                boolean found = false;\n                for (Combatant c : session.order) {\n                    if (c.name.equals(target)) {\n                        found = true;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (!found) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unknown target\");\n\n                storage.addCondition(id, target, condition, durationRounds);\n                session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"target\", target);\n                List<Map<String, Object>> conditions = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Condition cond : session.conditions.get(target)) {\n                    Map<String, Object> condJson = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    condJson.put(\"condition\", cond.condition);\n                    condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                    conditions.add(condJson);\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else if (\"advance\".equals(action)) {\n                session.turnIndex++;\n                if (session.turnIndex >= session.order.size()) {\n                    session.turnIndex = 0;\n                    session.round++;\n                }\n                Combatant active = session.order.get(session.turnIndex);\n\n                storage.advanceCombatSession(session, active);\n                session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"id\", session.id);\n                res.put(\"round\", session.round);\n                res.put(\"turn_index\", session.turnIndex);\n                res.put(\"active\", combatantJson(active));\n                Map<String, Object> conditions = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                for (Map.Entry<String, List<Condition>> entry : session.conditions.entrySet()) {\n                    List<Map<String, Object>> condList = new ArrayList<>();\n                    for (Condition cond : entry.getValue()) {\n                        Map<String, Object> condJson = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                        condJson.put(\"condition\", cond.condition);\n                        condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                        condList.add(condJson);\n                    }\n                    conditions.put(entry.getKey(), condList);\n                }\n                if (!conditions.containsKey(active.name)) {\n                    conditions.put(active.name, new ArrayList<>());\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else {\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleRegister(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", name);\n                out.put(\"score\", score);\n                out.put(\"_dex\", dex);\n                combatants.add(out);\n      String nameA = (String) a.get(\"name\");\n                String nameB = (String) b.get(\"name\");\n                return nameA.compareTo(nameB);\n            });\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> order = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Map<String, Object> combatant : combatants) {\n                Map<String, Object> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                out.put(\"name\", combatant.get(\"name\"));\n                out.put(\"score\", combatant.get(\"score\"));\n                order.add(out);\n            }\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"order\", order);\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void handleAbilityModifier(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n handleCombatSessionAction(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 405,     return;\n        }\n        String id = rest.substring(0, slash);\n        String action = rest.substring(slash + 1);\n        CombatSession session = storage.getCombatSession(id);\n        if (\"conditions\".equals(action)) {\n                String body = HttpSupport.readBody(exchange);\n                Map<String, Object> req = JsonUtils.parseJsonObject(body);\n                String          if (target == null || condition == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n                if (durationRounds <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid duration\");\n\n                boolean found = false;\n                for (Combatant c : session.order) {\n                    if (c.name.equals(target)) {\n                        found = true;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (!found) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unknown target\");\n\n                storage.addCondition(id, target, condition, conditions.add(condJson);\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else session.round);\n                res.put(\"turn_index\", session.turnIndex);\n                res.put(\"active\", combatantJson(active));\n                Map<String, Object> conditions = new cond.condition);\n                        condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                        condList.add(condJson);\n                    }\n        }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 200, JsonUtils.toJson(res));\n            } else {\n                HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            HttpSupport.sendResponse(exchange, 400,    synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> sessionRows = query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = \" + quote(id) + \";\");\n            if (sessionRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n            Map<String, Object> sessionRow = sessionRows.get(0);\n\n            List<Combatant> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatantRows = query(\"SELECT name, score, dex, roll FROM combatants WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY sort_order;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : combatantRows) {\n                combatants.add(new Combatant((String) row.get(\"name\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"score\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"dex\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"roll\"))));\n            }\n\n            CombatSession session = new CombatSession((String) sessionRow.get(\"id\"), combatants);\n            session.round = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"round\"));\n            session.turnIndex = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"turn_index\"));\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> conditionRows = query(\"SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM conditions WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY id;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : conditionRows) {\n                String target = (String) row.get(\"target\");\n                session.conditions.computeIfAbsent(target, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(new Condition((String) row.get(\"condition\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"remaining_rounds\"))));\n            }\n\n            return session;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void addCondition(String sessionId, String target, String condition, int boolean updateQuestProgress(String campaignId, String id, List<String> completed) {\n        synchronized (lock) {\n            try {\n                List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n                sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n                for (String milestone : completed) {\n                    sqls.add(\"UPDATE quest_milestones SET completed = 1 WHERE quest_id = \" + quote(id) + \" AND campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND milestone = \" + quote(milestone) + \";\");\n                }\n                sqls.add(\"COMMIT;\");\n                execSql(sqls.toArray(new String[0]));\n\n                List<Map<String, Object>> rows = query(\"SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM quest_milestones WHERE quest_id = \" + quote(id) + \" AND campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \";\");\n                int total = JsonUtils.toInt(rows.get(0).get(\"total\"));\n                rows = query(\"SELECT COUNT(*) AS done FROM quest_milestones WHERE quest_id = \" + quote(id) + \" AND campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND completed = 1;\");\n                int done = JsonUtils.toInt(rows.get(0).get(\"done\"));\n                if (total > 0 && total == done) {\n                    execSql(\"UPDATE quests SET status = 'completed' WHERE id = \" + quote(id) + \" AND campaign_id = \" + quote(campaignId) + \" AND status != 'completed';\");\n                }\n                return true;\n            } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    public boolean insertFaction(String campaignId, String id, String name,
